title: Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis
function: Front upper wishbone rear leg chassis clevis (Ti-6246)
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is selected for Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis where unsprung mass reduction directly improves suspension response and lap times. The 45% density reduction vs steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at equivalent strength enables rod and link components to meet fatigue targets >10^6 cycles under dynamic racing loads. Elastic energy storage per unit mass (σ²/2Eρ = 18.5 kJ/kg) is 2.3× that of 4130 steel — optimal for Front upper wishbone rear leg chassis clevis (Ti-6246). This rationale is driven by front upper wishbone rear leg chassis clevis (ti-6246) and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for suspension geometry
Shot peening Almen at 200W fiber laser
Black oxide/DLC coating at 200W fiber laser
CMM SPC dimensional check at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for front upper wishbone application
commonFailures: Corrosion pitting in road salt exposure - mitigated by DLC 2um 15GPa + hot wax sealant — critical for front upper wishbone performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For front upper wishbone, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis?
faq.a: Each Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for front upper wishbone.
